description: Get source, existing environment IDs, deployment URLs, custom production domains, Dev access mode, latest operation and cleanup status. Dev may be absent; add it with project_development_add. Use preview_open to show the app, with environment dev on Paid when the project has Dev, or prod on Free or when Dev is absent. Give the protected Dev share_url from project_dev_share_link_get only when the user asks for the deployed Dev site. Select environments by name; never infer a Prod ID from the default environment.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: project_status
